statement.p: Parameterize the line through P = \left(-3,3\right) and Q = \left(3,11\right) so that the points P and Q correspond to the parameter values t = 12 and 15.

static.solution:
\overrightarrow{0P} = -3 \vec i + 3 \vec j from the origin to the point P and the displacement vector \overrightarrow{PQ} = 6 \vec i + 8 \vec j from P to Q.
\vec r(t) = \overrightarrow{OP} + \frac{(t - 12)}{3}\overrightarrow{PQ} or \vec r(t) = (-3 + 6\, \frac{(t - 12)}{3})\vec i + (3 + 8\, \frac{(t - 12)}{3})\vec j.
